interpretation: Evidence that is redundant for the current B0 survivor fiber can still have substantial value for future robustness because it excludes threatening worlds from future admissible expansion.
Barrier validation and analyst-rule validation had zero current B0 contraction by construction but positive future-lifetime value in 205/272 rows.
The diagnostic action maximizing immediate current-world contraction differed from the action maximizing future certificate lifetime in 178/272 rows.
Future-proof optimal actions were heterogeneous: source 94 rows, barrier 91, analyst rule 87.
A single truth-consistent diagnostic converted 1,585 threatened certificates from finite lifetime to K=0 full-pool survival across the frozen panel.
EOG evidence design therefore has at least two distinct objectives: identify the current state and future-proof a target certificate against declared world-universe growth.
claim_boundary: The three diagnostics have unit conceptual cost only and are not field-cost-equivalent.
Future-proof value is conditional on the frozen v8 all-source candidate growth pool.
Analyst-rule validation is a model/representation diagnostic rather than a literal ecological field measurement.
The result is a truth-path known-truth leverage audit, not expected pre-outcome utility.
